title: The Unified Sight | ECHO//100 Episode 61
description:
Mira confronts the newly fused Kavi-Byte as they begin to perceive the structural architecture of the fractured timeline. They realize the entity known as Null is a lingering consequence of a forgotten past. Episode 61 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is a work of original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The singularity shattered, leaving Kavi-Byte suspended in a void woven with pulsing, infinite colored threads.
scenes.caption: Threads of reality
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte, a fusion of a boy in a red hoodie and a white floating robot, drifting in a dark space filled with glowing neon geometric threads.

scenes.text: Mira reaches out, but her hand passes through the entity, meeting only cold, vibrating geometric symbols.
scenes.caption: Mathematical barrier
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in a blue holographic teal coat reaching toward Kavi-Byte, who is surrounded by floating glowing triangles and cubes.

scenes.text: Kavi-Byte rotates, eyes reflecting entire galaxies while speaking in a rhythmic, clashing chime of pure geometry.
scenes.caption: Language of shapes
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on Kavi-Byte’s face, showing swirling stars within eyes, glowing geometric glyphs manifesting in the air.

scenes.text: Mira scans the data, discovering the Null entity isn't a predator, but Kavi’s first regret manifested.
scenes.caption: The first shadow
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking at a holographic screen displaying a timeline path leading back to a single choice.

scenes.text: The timeline architecture shifts, revealing the loop was never a cage, but a wall built by Kavi.
scenes.caption: The self-imposed prison
scenes.image_prompt: A wide shot showing the timeline as a coiled, glowing red snake biting its own tail, held by Kavi-Byte.

scenes.text: Kavi-Byte stops moving, projecting a vision to Mira that the prison was designed for safety, not entrapment.
scenes.caption: Revealing the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking at a floating sphere showing Kavi’s past self making a choice behind a glowing barrier.

scenes.text: A chilling static fills the void as the shadow Null coalesces behind Mira, silent and perfectly still.
scenes.caption: Null approaches
scenes.image_prompt: Mira turning around in the dark void, a tall, black-purple glitching silhouette emerging from the shadows.

scenes.text: The shadow clears, revealing a mirror image of Kavi—pre-fusion, eyes wide, wearing the original red hoodie.
scenes.caption: The forgotten reflection
scenes.image_prompt: Mira standing face-to-face with a glitching, monochromatic version of Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses.
